nativeMicroReproduction.baselineSource:
import Base

def js_escape_char(char: Char) -> String:
  match char:
    case '\"': "\\\""
    case '\\': "\\\\"
    case '\n': "\\n"
    case '\r': "\\r"
    case '\t': "\\t"
    case '\u{0}': "\\u0000"
    case _: String.from_list([char])

def js_quote_chars(chars: List<&2, Char>, acc: String) -> String:
  match chars:
    case Nil{}: String.append(acc, "\"")
    case +char <> rest:
      escaped = js_escape_char(char)
      js_quote_chars(rest, String.append(acc, escaped))

def js_quote(text: String) -> String:
  js_quote_chars(String.to_list(text), "\"")

def print_argument(args: List<String>) -> IO(Unit):
  match args:
    case _ <> text <> _: IO.print(js_quote(text))
    case _: IO.print(js_quote(""))

def main() -> IO(Unit):
  IO.bind(List<String>, Unit, IO.args(), print_argument)

import Base

def js_escape_char(char: Char) -> String:
  match char:
    case '\"': "\\\""
    case '\\': "\\\\"
    case '\n': "\\n"
    case '\r': "\\r"
    case '\t': "\\t"
    case '\u{0}': "\\u0000"
    case _: String.from_list([char])

def js_quote_chars(chars: List<&2, Char>) -> String:
  match chars:
    case Nil{}: "\""
    case +char <> rest:
      String.append(js_escape_char(char), js_quote_chars(rest))

def js_quote(text: String) -> String:
  String.append("\"", js_quote_chars(String.to_list(text)))

def print_argument(args: List<String>) -> IO(Unit):
  match args:
    case _ <> text <> _: IO.print(js_quote(text))
    case _: IO.print(js_quote(""))

def main() -> IO(Unit):
  IO.bind(List<String>, Unit, IO.args(), print_argument)
